prompts.prompt: A candid Instagram-style lifestyle photograph, shot on a smartphone, of a beautiful young woman in her mid-twenties, clearly an adult and a fictional synthetic person, sitting on a sunlit weathered wooden boardwalk by the sea on a summer evening. She sits relaxed and casual with her knees slightly bent and her bare feet resting on the planks in front of her, both feet clearly visible in the frame with natural proportions: five toes on each foot, natural toenails, no extra or fused toes. One hand rests on the boards beside her and the other lightly tucks a strand of hair behind her ear, both hands with five correctly formed fingers. She has long light-brown wavy hair with a few flyaway strands in the sea breeze, natural skin with visible pores, a light tan and a few freckles, and a relaxed natural smile as she looks toward the camera. She wears a light, loose, knee-length white and pale-yellow summer dress, fully covered, casual and modest. Golden-hour sun low and to the side gives warm rim light and soft shadows; behind her the sea and a wooden railing are softly out of focus, a little sand blown over the planks. Smartphone photo look: 26 mm lens, natural HDR, slightly warm colours, mild grain, no beauty filter, no retouching, full seated pose from head to feet, vertical 9:16 frame.
